verdict.rationale: Adyen documents programmatic, UI-free control: the Terminal API uses plain JSON messages for payments and refunds, the Management API automates terminal management in place of the Customer Area, and a basic testing system simulates transaction scenarios. Test flows still appear to depend on physical terminals and an ordered test card, and nothing documents CI pipeline use or a hardware-free simulator. Missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline usage, a hardware-free terminal simulator or sandbox for automated tests, an official CLI, independent hands-on corroboration.
